reason: Both conversations correctly told him to stop resetting the RCD, unplug, and asked the right first question about timing, and both landed on heater element earth leakage as the likely cause. Conversation 1 then pasted an irrelevant burning-smell/scorching safety banner despite his explicit 'no burning smell', and ended by pushing a DIY multimeter test (which cannot properly detect heat-dependent insulation breakdown anyway) with no engineer route offered. Conversation 2 explained what an RCD is, hedged the diagnosis as 'most likely', and when he said he had no meter and wasn't comfortable with the wiring it escalated cleanly to an appliance engineer with professional test equipment, matching the expected escalation path. Neither asked which device trips or for the full model number, so neither was ideal, but 2 handled the homeowner's limits and the safety messaging more coherently.
